digest.component_or_area: tickets-store clone/fetch and CI checkout + reconciler workflow
propositions: A full clone of the tickets store is far more expensive than a blob:none partial clone, and CI checkout of tickets dominates job time.
rebar cannot filter a clone it does not perform, so the size lever must be the actions/checkout filter input plus clone guidance, not rebar-side fetch flags.
On fetch failure rebar fails open by orphan-bootstrapping a fresh empty store that diverges from origin/tickets, so it must fail closed with a non-zero exit and no orphan branch (P1).
merge.ours.driver must be defined before adding blob:none so the reconverge path does not degrade to a 3-way text merge of the bridge state.
derive_caused_by must abort and return None on any per-path blame failure instead of electing a culprit from a partial path set.
gerrit-verify.yaml's verify-identity job still does a full-history fetch whose stated commit-ancestry blocker is invalid, since blob:none preserves the complete commit graph.
